Restaurantes.founderBanner: Be among the first. The first 100 establishments receive the Founder badge.
Restaurantes.heroBadge: For restaurants and cafés in Valencia
Restaurantes.heroTitle: We've made choosing a restaurant easy.
Restaurantes.heroDesc: Every day there are indecisive people looking for where to eat in Valencia. With DimeSitio, your restaurant appears right when they're looking for you.
Restaurantes.loginLink: Already have an account? Sign in
Restaurantes.problemsTitle: The problem isn't competition. It's that they can't find you.
Restaurantes.problemsDesc: Your potential customers are out there, browsing Google Maps and unable to decide. We bring them to your door.
Restaurantes.problem1Title: Customers who already want what you offer
Restaurantes.problem1Desc: Users choose by cuisine type, price, and area. When someone selects your category, they're already inclined towards what you offer. It's not cold traffic — these are diners who have chosen.
Restaurantes.problem2Desc: Your investment pays back quickly with the first customers we bring you. No ads or bidding: every recommendation is a new diner arriving at your door.
Restaurantes.problem3Desc: When a user reaches your listing, they've already decided what type of food they fancy. They're not just curious — they're someone going out to dine and looking for a place.
Restaurantes.howTitle: From signing up to receiving customers in 3 steps
Restaurantes.step1Desc: Sign up and add your restaurant in less than 5 minutes. Cuisine type, prices, area, photos, and a link to the menu.
Restaurantes.step2Desc: When someone searches for exactly what you offer, our algorithm will show your restaurant among the best options.
Restaurantes.step3Desc: They view your listing, check the menu, open directions, or call. You just need to be there with up-to-date information.
Restaurantes.founderTitle: Be one of the 100 founding establishments
Restaurantes.founderDesc: The first 100 establishments to join DimeSitio receive the Founder badge. A distinction that users see and that recognizes those who arrived first.
Restaurantes.founderAdvantage: Besides recognition, founding restaurants always appear first in results. An exclusive advantage for the first 100 establishments.
Restaurantes.stat1Label: Customers already looking for what you offer
Restaurantes.stat2Label: Recommendations to those already searching for you
Restaurantes.bottomTitle: Don't let them tell you what they're looking for. Be the answer.
Restaurantes.bottomDesc: Register your establishment and start appearing before Valencia's indecisive diners.

Landing.badge: Find the perfect spot in Valencia in under a minute
Landing.heroSubtitle: Stop wasting 40 minutes choosing a restaurant.
Landing.ctaSubtext: Fast, free, and no signup required.
Landing.galleryTitle: More than {count} cuisine types to choose from
Landing.cafeTitle: Also for those who prefer the morning
Landing.cafeDesc: DimeSitio isn't just for dinners. Find specialty cafés where the barista knows your name, brunch spots with spectacular eggs benedict, and independent places with that vibe you won't find in any chain.
Landing.cafe1Desc: Local roasters, alternative brewing methods, and latte art that's almost too pretty to drink. Pour-over, espresso, or cold brew — each coffee has its moment.
Landing.cafe2Desc: From classic pancakes to Valencia's most Instagrammable avocado toast. Midday menus that turn any Saturday into a plan.
Landing.cafe3Desc: Natural light, plants, vinyl music, and wooden tables. Places to settle in to work, read, or just be. The plan you didn't know you needed.
Landing.problemsTitle: Choosing a restaurant shouldn't take longer than the meal
Landing.problemsQuote: "Where are we eating today?" — the question that ends with 40 minutes staring at Google Maps only to end up at the same place as always.
Landing.problem0Desc: Forget comparing dozens of restaurants. Choose cuisine type, budget, and area, and we'll do the rest.
Landing.problem1Desc: You don't need to see a hundred places to find a good one. We only show you the options that really fit you.
Landing.problem2Desc: Check the menu, open directions, or call the restaurant directly. No hassle. No stress.
Landing.bottomTitle: Your next restaurant is less than a minute away
Landing.bottomDesc: Answer 3 questions and decide without overthinking.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: Welcome to DimeSitio. The following terms govern the use of the platform and the relationship between DimeSitio and its users. We recommend that you read them carefully before using our services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.content: By accessing and using DimeSitio (hereinafter, "the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any of them, you must not use the Platform. These terms apply to all users, both those browsing anonymously and registered restaurant owners.

sections.title: 2. Description of the service
sections.content: DimeSitio is a platform that allows users to discover restaurants in Valencia through a quick questions system, and restaurant owners to promote their establishments and receive inquiries from potential customers. The service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of continuous availability or error-free operation.

sections.title: 3. Restaurant registration
sections.content: To create and manage an establishment on DimeSitio, the user must register and provide truthful and updated information. The user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their access credentials and all activities that occur under their account. DimeSitio reserves the right to reject or cancel any registration without the need for justification.

sections.title: 4. Subscriptions and payments
sections.content: The registration and maintenance of an establishment on the Platform requires a paid subscription. The applicable price will be the one published on the website at the time of contracting, with different rates possibly existing depending on the type of subscription or current promotions. Payment is processed through Stripe, and by contracting you accept its terms of service. Subscriptions are automatically renewed and can be canceled at any time from the management panel. DimeSitio reserves the right to modify prices with prior notice to subscribed users with at least 30 days' notice.

sections.title: 5. Cancellations
sections.content: The user may cancel their subscription at any time from the control panel. The cancellation will be effective at the end of the current billing period. No partial refunds will be made for unused periods. DimeSitio reserves the right to suspend or cancel access to the Platform if these terms are violated.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
sections.content: All content on the Platform (logos, texts, images, design) is the property of Studio Muxa Tech, S.L. or is used under license. Content provided by restaurant owners is their responsibility and they guarantee they have the right to publish it.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.content: DimeSitio acts solely as an intermediary between users and restaurants. We are not responsible for the quality of service, accuracy of information published by restaurants, or relationships established between users and establishments. The Platform is provided without warranties of any kind, express or implied.

sections.title: 8. Applicable legislation
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions are governed by Spanish legislation. For any controversy arising from the use of the Platform, the parties submit to the courts and tribunals of Valencia, expressly renouncing any other jurisdiction that may correspond to them.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.content: For any questions about these terms, you can write to us at info@muxatech.com or visit our registered office: Duque de Calabria 3, 10, 46005 Valencia, Valencia.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: The data controller for your personal data is Studio Muxa Tech, S.L. (CIF B16378309), located at Duque de Calabria 3, 10, 46005 Valencia, Valencia. You can contact us at info@muxatech.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.content:
We collect the following data depending on the type of user:

• Anonymous users: a unique session identifier randomly generated (does not allow identifying the person). No name, email, or personal data is collected.
• Restaurant owners: name, email, phone, establishment address, and billing data managed through Stripe (we do not directly store credit card data).
• Browsing data: pages visited, platform interactions, device type, and browser.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of processing
sections.content:
Your data is processed for the following purposes:

• Providing the restaurant discovery and promotion service.
• Managing subscriptions, billing, and payments through Stripe.
• Sending service-related communications (call alerts, activity notifications).
• Improving the platform through aggregated usage analysis.
• Complying with legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.content:
The processing of your data is based on:

• Execution of the service contract (GDPR art. 6.1.b) for account and subscription management.
• User consent (GDPR art. 6.1.a) for marketing communications and browsing analysis.
• Legitimate interest (GDPR art. 6.1.f) for service improvement and fraud prevention.
• Legal obligations (GDPR art. 6.1.c) for regulatory compliance.

sections.title: 5. Third-party data sharing
sections.content:
Your data may be shared with:

• Stripe (Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd.) — for payment processing. Stripe operates under strict security measures and complies with PCI DSS. More information at stripe.com/privacy.
• Resend (Resend Inc.) — for sending transactional emails. More information at resend.com/legal/privacy-policy.
• Supabase (Supabase Inc.) — as database infrastructure and authentication provider. More information at supabase.com/privacy.

We do not share data with third parties for advertising purposes or sell personal data under any circumstances.

sections.title: 6. User rights
sections.content:
In accordance with the GDPR and LOPDGDD, you have the right to:

• Access your personal data.
• Rectify inaccurate data.
• Request deletion of your data when no longer needed.
• Limit processing in certain circumstances.
• Port your data to another controller.
• Object to processing based on legitimate interest.

To exercise your rights, send an email to info@muxatech.com indicating the right you wish to exercise. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
sections.content: We retain your personal data while you maintain an active account on the platform. After account cancellation, data will be retained for the legally required period for compliance with fiscal and accounting obligations (generally 5 years), and subsequently will be securely deleted.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.content: DimeSitio uses technical cookies necessary for platform operation (session storage). We do not use behavioral advertising cookies or third-party tracking cookies. You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although some platform functionalities may be affected.

sections.title: 9. Modifications
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy. Changes will be notified through the platform or by email to registered users. We recommend periodically reviewing this page.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.content: For any questions about privacy or exercising your rights, you can write to us at info@muxatech.com or visit our registered office: Duque de Calabria 3, 10, 46005 Valencia, Valencia.
